title: Analytics Authenticationmethodchangesold
author: ep3p
description: This query can help you to check accounts that changed their MFA or Authentication Methods in Azure AD Click "Save as function", in Parameters write in the fields: "timespan" "query_period"        "1d" "dynamic"  "query_userids"       "dynamic([])" "bool"     "check_signinlogs"    "false" If you name the function "AuthenticationMethodChanges", you can check the function with queries like the following: AuthenticationMethodChanges() AuthenticationMethodChanges(2d, dynamic(["00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000","00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"])) let Function = (query_period:timespan = 1d, query_userids:dynamic = dynamic([]), check_signinlogs:bool = true){ CoreDirectory Resources
